title: OpenRouter: one endpoint for several providers

videos.script: OpenRouter is one key and one address in front of hundreds of models. {{one-key}} It passes the providers' prices through, and charges when you buy credits instead. {{routing}} Behind each model there can be several providers. OpenRouter picks one for each request, by price, unless you say otherwise, and the response says which one it was. {{fallbacks}} A list of models is a fallback: if the first cannot answer, the next one does, and your evaluation now covers two models. {{data}} And by default, a provider that keeps your data and may train on it is allowed. One field turns that off.
